original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦首都区传统统治者妻子协会加大力度打击性别暴力
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦首都区传统统治者妻子协会（WOFCTTRA）表示正加大力度消除农村社区的性别暴力。协会主席、阿巴吉酋长领地王后哈吉娅·豪瓦·阿达穆称，协会借助传统宫廷的道德权威保护受害者、惩处施暴者并打破对家庭暴力的沉默。她表示已说服传统统治者在各自领地内实施严厉制裁，并称相关案件已大幅减少。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚联邦首都区传统统治者妻子协会加大力度消除农村社区性别暴力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Association of Wives of Federal Capital Territory Traditional Rulers (WOFCTTRA) has stepped up efforts to eradicate Gender-Based Violence (GBV) across rural communities in the territory.

key_facts.fact: 协会主席称已说服传统统治者在各自领地内实施严厉制裁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: She added that to enforce accountability, WOFCTTRA has successfully persuaded traditional rulers to enact strict sanctions within their respective domains.

key_facts.fact: 协会主席称相关案件已大幅减少
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Because of this, people are afraid now, and cases have drastically reduced

key_facts.fact: 协会在阿巴吉酋长领地开展安全孕产宣传，覆盖300多名农村妇女
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: in Abaji Chiefdom, the association has led safe motherhood campaigns, reaching more than 300 rural women on the critical importance of antenatal care and exclusive breastfeeding

uncertainties: 案件减少幅度等成效数据为协会主席单方面说法，未获独立证实
信息来源为单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社NAN）
